title: Autonomous Agents Hit Hard Reality As OpenAI Safety Lead Resigns | AI Progress Daily
description:
Today on AI Progress Daily, we explore Microsoft's ThinkingBox revealing hard truths about agent reliability, why agents need documentation over memory, and an open-source harness pumping out thirty-six scientific manuscripts. Plus, quiet meetings at Anthropic and another major departure from OpenAI.
